documents.name: kestrel-rates.md
documents.text:
# Kestrel Freight pricing notes

Standard pallet rate is 42 dollars per pallet within the Northern region. Cross-region pallets cost 58 dollars.

Cold-chain surcharge is 12 percent of the freight charge. Fuel surcharge is reviewed on the first Monday of each quarter.

Contracts of 12 months or longer get a 7 percent volume discount. Payment terms are net 30 days.

documents.name: harbor-clinic-onboarding.md
documents.text:
# Harbor Clinic onboarding

The clinic has three sites: Millbrook, Eastgate and Ferrow Street. The main contact is Dana Whitcombe, the practice manager.

Go-live is planned for 14 March. Staff training takes two half-days and is held at the Eastgate site.

The clinic sends appointment reminders by text message, 48 hours before each visit. Data is exported nightly at 02:00.

documents.name: alder-finch-terms.md
documents.text:
# Alder and Finch Studio engagement terms

The project is a brand refresh with a fixed fee of 18,500 dollars. The fee is paid in three instalments: 40 percent on signing, 30 percent at the first review and 30 percent on delivery.

The studio includes two rounds of revisions. A third round is billed at 95 dollars an hour.

The agreed delivery date is 30 June. Ownership of the final artwork passes to the client once the last instalment is paid.

documents.name: meadowbrook-school-notes.md
documents.text:
# Meadowbrook School timetable project notes

The school has 640 students and 48 teachers. The term starts on 8 September and ends on 19 December.

The head of operations, Priya Nandakumar, wants parent notices sent in English and Vietnamese. The pilot covers Year 7 and Year 8 only.

The school network blocks outgoing traffic except on port 443, so integrations must use HTTPS.

documents.name: tidewell-support-policy.md
documents.text:
# Tidewell Cafes support policy

Support is available Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00 Central time. Urgent tickets get a first reply within 2 hours; normal tickets within 1 business day.

The escalation contact is Marcus Oyelaran, reachable at extension 4417. Refunds above 500 dollars need written approval from the finance lead.

The till system is updated on the second Tuesday of every month.

documents.name: song-xanh-ghi-chu.md
documents.text:
# Ghi chú khách hàng Sông Xanh

Công ty Sông Xanh bán thiết bị làm vườn và có 25 nhân viên. Người liên hệ chính là chị Lê Thu Hà, giám đốc vận hành.

Hợp đồng bảo trì phần mềm có phí 6 triệu đồng mỗi tháng. Công ty muốn bắt đầu vào ngày 1 tháng 10.

Giờ làm việc của công ty là từ 8 giờ đến 17 giờ, từ thứ Hai đến thứ Bảy.
